title: 鐵路回流與雜散電流控制
summary: 鐵路回流與雜散電流控制以「回路電位分流與雜散電荷控制」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。牽引回流、軌地電位與雜散電流是不同量；減少一處電位可能把電流轉向其他路徑，需用完整網路及時間電荷帳判斷。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。
summaryEn: This course develops return potential current division and stray-charge control through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. Traction return current, rail-earth potential and stray current are distinct; reducing voltage at one point can divert current elsewhere, requiring a complete network and time-integrated charge. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 鋼軌回流壓降與平行回流分配
stages.titleEn: Rail-return voltage drop & Parallel return sharing
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「鋼軌回流壓降」與「平行回流分配」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Rail-return voltage drop" and "Parallel return sharing": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 鋼軌回流壓降：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Rail-return voltage drop: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「鋼軌回流壓降」如何影響鐵路回流與雜散電流控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rail-return voltage drop” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rail-return and stray-current control”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 回流鋼軌有限電阻產生沿程電位差。本模型把 I 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 16.5 V。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。穩態單一路徑。使用回流電流與兩點軌電位作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；接續線劣化會增加局部壓降，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「鋼軌回流壓降」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Finite return-rail resistance produces longitudinal potential difference. In this model, I is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 16.5 V. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Steady single return path. Use return current and rail potentials at two points as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. A degraded bond increases local voltage drop; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Rail-return voltage drop” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：I=1000 A, R=0.015 ohm；y=I*R=15 V。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: I=1000 A, R=0.015 ohm; y=I*R=15 V.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：接續線劣化會增加局部壓降」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: A degraded bond increases local voltage drop." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「鋼軌回流壓降」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Rail-return voltage drop”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Finite return-rail resistance produces longitudinal potential difference. In this model, I is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：接續線劣化會增加局部壓降 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: A degraded bond increases local voltage drop. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「鋼軌回流壓降」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Rail-return voltage drop" is correct?
options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：接續線劣化會增加局部壓降
回流鋼軌有限電阻產生沿程電位差。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：一路中斷會重分配全回路電流
optionsEn: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: A degraded bond increases local voltage drop.
Finite return-rail resistance produces longitudinal potential difference.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Opening one path redistributes total return current.
quiz.explanation: 回流鋼軌有限電阻產生沿程電位差。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Finite return-rail resistance produces longitudinal potential difference. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 鋼軌回流壓降：定量估算
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鋼軌回流壓降」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Rail-return voltage drop” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：I=1000 A, R=0.015 ohm；y=I*R=15 V。只把 I 增加百分之十，y=16.5 V。模型邊界：穩態單一路徑；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: I=1000 A, R=0.015 ohm; y=I*R=15 V. Increasing only I with a ten-percent increase gives y=16.5 V. Boundary: Steady single return path; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以回流電流與兩點軌電位區分模型與觀察，先用低壓電阻鏈與差動電表建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use return current and rail potentials at two points to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：I=1000 A, R=0.015 ohm；y=I*R=15 V。只把 I 增加百分之十，y=16.5 V。模型邊界：穩態單一路徑；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Rail-return voltage drop", which statement holds?
options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：用絕對電流積分會混淆陽極與陰極時段

steps.title: 鋼軌回流壓降：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Rail-return voltage drop: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「鋼軌回流壓降」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Rail-return voltage drop” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以回流電流與兩點軌電位區分模型與觀察，先用低壓電阻鏈與差動電表建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「鋼軌回流壓降」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use return current and rail potentials at two points to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using low-voltage resistor chain and differential voltmeter, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Rail-return voltage drop. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「鋼軌回流壓降」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出穩態單一路徑如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由接續線劣化會增加局部壓降造成偏離的合成觀察，以回流電流與兩點軌電位說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Rail-return voltage drop, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Steady single return path. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: A degraded bond increases local voltage drop. Explain which evidence in return current and rail potentials at two points distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：接續線劣化會增加局部壓降。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A degraded bond increases local voltage drop. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 本單元以回流電流與兩點軌電位區分模型與觀察，先用低壓電阻鏈與差動電表建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「鋼軌回流壓降」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。

Establish a baseline using low-voltage resistor chain and differential voltmeter, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Rail-return voltage drop. quiz.question: 要驗證「鋼軌回流壓降」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Rail-return voltage drop"?
options: 本單元以回流電流與兩點軌電位區分模型與觀察，先用低壓電阻鏈與差動電表建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。

steps.title: 鋼軌回流壓降：失效診斷
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鋼軌回流壓降」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Rail-return voltage drop” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 接續線劣化會增加局部壓降。這個失效與「鋼軌回流壓降」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查回流電流與兩點軌電位，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A degraded bond increases local voltage drop. This failure and a measurement bias in Rail-return voltage drop can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check return current and rail potentials at two points rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用回流電流與兩點軌電位作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；接續線劣化會增加局部壓降，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A degraded bond increases local voltage drop; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：接續線劣化會增加局部壓降」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: A degraded bond increases local voltage drop." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 接續線劣化會增加局部壓降。這個失效與「鋼軌回流壓降」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查回流電流與兩點軌電位，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。
knowledge.textEn: A degraded bond increases local voltage drop. This failure and a measurement bias in Rail-return voltage drop can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check return current and rail potentials at two points rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「鋼軌回流壓降」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Rail-return voltage drop" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

steps.instruction: 平行路徑以相同端電壓按電阻反比分流。本模型把 It 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 366.667 A。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。兩個純電阻並聯。使用鋼軌與回流線電流作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；一路中斷會重分配全回路電流，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「平行回流分配」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Parallel paths share terminal voltage and divide current inversely with resistance. In this model, It is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 366.667 A. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Two purely resistive parallel paths. Use rail and return-cable currents as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Opening one path redistributes total return current; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Parallel return sharing” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：It=1000 A, Rrail=0.02 ohm, Rcable=0.01 ohm；y=It*Rcable/(Rrail+Rcable)=333.333 A。只把 It 增加百分之十，y=366.667 A。模型邊界：兩個純電阻並聯；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: It=1000 A, Rrail=0.02 ohm, Rcable=0.01 ohm; y=It*Rcable/(Rrail+Rcable)=333.333 A. Increasing only It with a ten-percent increase gives y=366.667 A. Boundary: Two purely resistive parallel paths; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以鋼軌與回流線電流區分模型與觀察，先用隔離低壓支路電流量測建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use rail and return-cable currents to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Parallel return sharing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以鋼軌與回流線電流區分模型與觀察，先用隔離低壓支路電流量測建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「平行回流分配」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use rail and return-cable currents to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using isolated low-voltage branch-current measurements, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Parallel return sharing. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「平行回流分配」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出兩個純電阻並聯如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由一路中斷會重分配全回路電流造成偏離的合成觀察，以鋼軌與回流線電流說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Parallel return sharing, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Two purely resistive parallel paths. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Opening one path redistributes total return current. Explain which evidence in rail and return-cable currents distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：一路中斷會重分配全回路電流。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Opening one path redistributes total return current. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 平行回流分配：失效診斷
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「平行回流分配」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

steps.instruction: 一路中斷會重分配全回路電流。這個失效與「平行回流分配」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查鋼軌與回流線電流，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Opening one path redistributes total return current. This failure and a measurement bias in Parallel return sharing can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check rail and return-cable currents rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：一路中斷會重分配全回路電流」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Opening one path redistributes total return current." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
